findings.title: Empty coordinator plans bypass max_rounds and permit unbounded billed calls
findings.description: The per-session max_rounds gate only counts COMMITTED rounds. When the coordinator returns a valid plan with respondents:[], execute_round returns successfully without committing the user turn or advancing current_round. A caller can submit unlimited requests that each invoke the coordinator LLM while the session remains at the same round and never reaches max_rounds. Both gateway handlers perform the same current_round >= max_rounds check and so do not close this gap.
findings.trigger: A session is created with finite max_rounds, and the coordinator repeatedly returns valid JSON whose respondents array is empty; the client repeatedly calls group_chat.continue.
findings.suggested_fix: Track no_commit_attempts on GroupChatSession; bump on every empty-plan commit, reset on every successful commit, and reject a new attempt once it reaches max_no_commit_attempts() = clamp(max_rounds.unwrap_or(8), 4, 16).

notes: Read-only review of all eight production files. Prior findings from the 2026-08-31 pass (cancellation, ownership, validation, staging) all hold. The new finding is the empty-plan / max_rounds interaction, fixed by adding a separate no_commit_attempts counter on GroupChatSession and gating it alongside max_rounds. Two regression tests pin the behaviour.
